question: How does great bliss continue within the all-encompassing triad?
premises: It proceeds again within a specific triad.
That triad has assumed all the right, left, and upper aspects.
inference: Therefore great bliss, transformed into consciousness-bliss, continues to unfold within the triad that integrates right, left, and upper.
plain_english: Great bliss, having become the bliss of consciousness, proceeds again in this triad that has taken in all the right, left, and upper aspects.
